name: Ka'ana Resort
insider_take: Hidden in Belize's lush rainforest canopy, Ka'ana Resort offers an intimate jungle escape where howler monkeys serve as your morning alarm clock and ancient Mayan ruins lie just minutes away.
whats_special: This boutique eco-luxury resort sits on 400 acres of pristine rainforest, featuring just 15 suites and villas designed with indigenous hardwoods and local craftsmanship. The property operates its own organic farm and apiary, supplying fresh ingredients to their award-winning restaurant while maintaining a delicate balance with the surrounding ecosystem.
pro_tip: Book the Cecropia Villa for the ultimate experience – it's perched in the treetops with floor-to-ceiling windows offering unobstructed jungle views and frequent wildlife sightings right from your bedroom.
dont_miss: The resort's guided night walks reveal a completely different jungle world with glowing eyes, nocturnal sounds, and bioluminescent fungi. Also explore nearby Caracol, Belize's largest Mayan site, where you can climb the 143-foot Caana pyramid – taller than any building in modern Belize.
pros: Luxury jungle setting with exceptional privacy and tranquility
World-class spa with authentic Mayan-inspired treatments
Prime location for exploring ancient Mayan ruins and cave systems
Gourmet farm-to-table dining with local ingredients
cons: Remote jungle location requires planning for outside activities
Limited nightlife and shopping options in immediate area
